## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix failure-report selection so reruns include requested tests whose paths the runner spells with a `./` prefix.

## Changes
The pull request adds selection from a runner’s failure report, rewrites the cached-path filter as a list comprehension, and adds tests for all three selectors.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/selection.py:20 — correctness — Match dot-prefixed failure paths — A report containing `./tests/test_x.py` returns an empty selection when `tests/test_x.py` is requested. `select_failures` compares the raw path directly, while both existing selectors normalize paths before matching. — A rerun silently skips a requested failed test when the runner includes a `./` prefix. — Fix: Use `select_explicit(report["failed"], requested)` to match normalized paths and preserve the report’s spelling, then extend `test_failure_report_selection`.

## Suggestions
- app/selection.py:15 — tests — Test exclusion of unrequested cached paths — No test exercises the rewritten filter with a cached path outside `requested`, such as `./tests/test_y.py` when only `tests/test_x.py` is requested. — Returning every normalized cached path would still pass the cached-selector test. — Fix: Extend `test_cached_paths_are_normalized_by_caller`.

## Not reviewed
(none)
